title: The Watch Needs Eyes
summary: Halden writes that the Blackwater Cartel is poisoning the valley and paying a third of every emerald to the cult. The Watch can't get close. You can. Meet the Captain of the Watch.

quest_book.title: The Watch Needs Eyes
quest_book.author: Reeve Halden
pages: There's a cartel in the valley called Blackwater. They sell weed, hash, worse. People are dying of it.
And a third of every emerald they make goes to the Chariot. Every sale keeps the cult's beasts fed.

The Watch has a captain who wants them gone and can't get close. You can. Go and see her.

- Halden

threats.name: Captain of the Watch
talk: Their supply line runs through a pillager outpost. Break it and their runners starve.
Because the Watch is twelve farmers with spears. You're you.
